about_the_game:
NEOHELL is a fast-paced survivors-like roguelite shooter with a round-based progression system inspired by the iconic Zombies Mode from Call of Duty.

In a cyberpunk post-apocalyptic world torn apart by war, the dead rise again — not as zombies, but as demons possessed by an unknown force. You are one of the few survivors with enough firepower (and sheer madness) to face them.

Fight through endless waves, upgrade your arsenal and abilities, and make every round count. NEOHELL combines intense twin-stick shooter mechanics with roguelite randomness and an evolving difficulty curve that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

KEY FEATURES

  • Frantic survivors-style combat – Mow down waves of enemies in every direction in classic twin-stick fashion.

  • Round-based progression – Inspired by Zombies mode. Survive increasingly difficult rounds with brief moments to upgrade your gear and catch your breath.

  • Roguelite replayability – Every run is different. Unlock new characters, maps, weapons, abilities, and power-ups to survive.

  • Cyberpunk meets hell – Explore dark, neon-lit maps where technology and the occult collide.

  • Unique deadly enemies – Dodge, adapt, and overcome different enemy types with distinct behaviors and attack styles.

  • Slick pixel-art visuals – Beautiful sprites and effects crafted with love, inspired by retro aesthetics but built for modern chaos.

  • Pulse-pounding soundtrack – Electronic, industrial, and synthwave tracks to match the intensity of the battlefield.

TRY THE FREE DEMO

A free demo will be available soon! Get a taste of the chaos, experience the core gameplay loop, and leave your feedback. Your support and suggestions will help shape the future of NEOHELL.

ARE YOU READY TO ENTER THE NEOHELL?

Survive the madness. Defy the odds. Embrace the chaos.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+
  • Processor: Dual Core CPU - Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (Intel HD 530 or better)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04+
  • Processor: Quad Core CPU - Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (GTX 1050 / RX 560 or better)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
